label: ASSUMED reference prices - illustrative snapshot, NOT live billing data
captured: 2026-10-12, entered manually by the RetrainWise author; not fetched from a billing API
verification_status: Not verified against live provider pages in this build. Values are commonly cited historical on-demand Linux list prices and are used only to give the simulated compute-cost term a realistic scale. Re-check the provider pages before relying on them.

cheap.description: Small CPU instance, largely automated pipeline, low deployment risk.

balanced.description: Mid-size CPU instance, an engineer reviews data and validation, moderate risk.

expensive.description: GPU instance, regulated sign-off and re-certification, high deployment risk.

notes: Engineer hourly rate and incident cost come from Settings (assumed USD).
Compute hours scale with training rows: hours_per_10k_rows * max(0.25, rows / 10000).
The cost-trace multiplier varies the compute price over time (diurnal or spot-like); labour is not traced.
Deployment-risk cost is an expected value: incident_probability * incident_cost.
Engineer-hour and incident figures are synthetic assumptions; no public dataset provides them.
